Name: Ephrath, Wife of Caleb
Summary: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron after Azubah, and mother of Hur.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:19: Wife of Caleb son of Hezron after Azubah, and mother of Hur.
LifeLesson: The mention of Ephrath in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
